G5880737.description: Utulei or ʻUtulei is a village in Maoputasi County, in the Eastern District of Tutuila, the main island of American Samoa. Utulei is traditionally considered to be a section of Fagatogo village, the legislative capital of American Samoa, and is located on the southwest edge of Pago Pago Harbor.

G5880755.description: Afono (Samoan: Āfono) is a village on the northeast coast of Tutuila Island, American Samoa. One of the island's more populous villages, it is located on the edge of Afono Bay, at the eastern edge of the National Park of American Samoa.

G5880764.description: Alao is a village on the narrow east coast of Tutuila Island, American Samoa. It is located close to the island's easternmost point, just to the north of Aunu'u Island.

G5880828.description: Aūa is a village on Tutuila Island in American Samoa. It is located along American Samoa Highway 001, and is the southern terminus of American Samoa Highway 006.

G5880833.description: Aʻoloau is a village in the west of Tutuila Island, American Samoa. It is located inland, 5 miles (8 km) southwest of Pago Pago.

G5880891.description: Vaitogi is a village in American Samoa. It has many missionaries and tourists who are attracted by shopping for local products.

G5880944.description: human settlement in Western District, American Samoa, United States of America

G5881150.description: Swains Island (; Tokelauan: Olohega Tokelauan pronunciation: [oloˈhɛŋa] ; Samoan: Olosega Samoan pronunciation: [oloˈsɛŋa] ), also known as Jennings Island, is a remote coral atoll in the Tokelau volcanic island group in the South Pacific Ocean. Administered as part of American Samoa since 1925, the island is subject to an ongoing territorial dispute between Tokelau and the United States.

G5881165.description: human settlement in United States of America

G5881168.description: Taputimu is a village in southwestern Tutuila Island in American Samoa. It is the nearest village to the Fagatele Bay National Marine Sanctuary, although the main access is from the neighboring village of Futiga.

G5881192.description: Tafuna (Samoan: Tāfuna) is a village in Tualauta County, Western District, American Samoa. It is the most populous village in American Samoa, with a population of 7,988 according to the 2020 U.S. census.

G5881224.description: Faleniu is a village in the west of Tutuila Island, American Samoa. It is located inland from the village of Tafuna, in Tuālāuta County.

G5881241.description: Fagatogo (Samoan pronunciation: [faŋatoŋo] ) is the downtown area of Pago Pago (the territorial capital of American Samoa). Located in the low grounds at the foot of Matafao Peak, it was the location of the first American settlement on Tutuila Island.

G5881254.description: Faleāsao is a village in American Samoa. Administratively, it is located in Faleāsao County, Manuʻa District, on the northern shore of Taʻū Island.

G5881342.description: Leloaloa is a village on Tutuila Island, American Samoa. It is located in Maoputasi County.

G5881347.description: Leone is the second-largest city on Tutuila Island's west coast. The village is on the south-west coast of Tutuila Island, American Samoa.

G5881401.description: Itūʻau, together with Aitūlagi, make up the village of Malaeloa (long ceremonial-green). Aitūlagi is the name of the famed family of high orator chiefs (tama matua) from the Leāsina county.

G5881409.description: Malaeloa/Aitulagi is a village in American Samoa. The neighboring village to the south is Malaeloa/Ituau.

G5881410.description: Malaeimi is a village in American Samoa, located in Tuālāuta County. The village is home to a large number of shops and restaurants, including eateries serving native cuisine alongside Filipino, Italian, Vietnamese, and American.

G5881433.description: Mapusaga is a small village located 9 miles (14 km) west of Pago Pago on Tutuila island in the American territory of American Samoa. Its coordinates are 14.33° south and 170.74389 ° west, with an elevation of 180 feet (55 m).

G5881442.description: human settlement in Western District, American Samoa, United States of America

G5881496.description: Mesepa is a village of American Samoa. It is in Tuālāuta on the main island of American Samoa, Tutuila.

G5881544.description: village on Ofu-Olosega in American Samoa

G5881576.description: Pago Pago is the capital of American Samoa. It is in Maoputasi County on Tutuila, the main island of American Samoa.

G5881602.description: Futiga (Samoan: Fūtiga; Samoan pronunciation: [fuːtiŋa] ) is a village in the southwest of Tutuila Island, American Samoa. It is located inland, 7 miles (11 km) southwest of Pago Pago, between the villages of 'Ili'ili and Puapua.
